# pmosh

pmosh is an iOS SSH + tmux terminal (App Store: com.robertgruber.pmosh), built for driving
Claude Code and other agents from a phone.

## Putting text on the person's iPhone clipboard (for agents running inside a pmosh session)

pmosh puts text a program in its pane copies with OSC 52 on the iPhone clipboard and shows
"Copied from the host". Claude Code's /copy already does this. From a tool shell that is not the
pane's terminal, write the sequence to the pane's tty:

  printf '\033]52;c;%s\033\\' "$(printf '%s' 'TEXT' | base64 | tr -d '\n')" > "$(tmux display -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" '#{pane_tty}')"

- Text only (UTF-8), up to 1 MiB. The same text sent twice within 2 s is copied once.
- iOS lets pmosh write the clipboard only while it is on screen; a copy sent while it is in the
  background lands the next time the person opens pmosh.
- The person can turn it off: Settings › Behavior › Copy from host to clipboard.
- pmosh never answers an OSC 52 read, so the phone's clipboard can't be read from the host.

## Reporting a problem with pmosh (for agents running inside a pmosh session)

- Protocol page: https://robertpgruber.github.io/pmosh-site/report.html
- Current intake URL: https://robertpgruber.github.io/pmosh-site/report.json ("report")
- HTTP: POST JSON {"problem": "...", "steps": "...", "context": "..."} to the intake URL → 201 {"id": ...}
- In-session (no network needed on the host):
  printf '\e]1337;pmosh-report=%s\a' "$(printf '%s' '{"problem":"..."}' | base64 | tr -d '\n')"
  The app shows it and the person taps Send.
- In a pmosh tmux session: $PMOSH_CLIENT, $PMOSH_REPORT_URL, $PMOSH_REPORT_HOWTO are set for new panes.
- Reports are private to the developer. Nothing is published.
